name: Contact validation flow
description: A walkthrough of composing three conduits with different access levels — write-only, review-and-update, and read-only — into one moderated submission flow, charted live as entries move through it.

name: Progressive enhancement form
description: One real form, submitted two ways — plain HTML with zero JavaScript, or the same markup enhanced with fetch() for an inline result. Toggle it live against a real conduit to see the difference.

name: Contact form
description: A ready-to-embed contact form with optional fields for qualifying leads.

name: Feedback
description: Collect five-star or NPS ratings with an optional comment.

name: Reactions
description: Collect a thumbs-up or thumbs-down response, one vote per subject and visitor.

name: RSVP
description: Collect yes, no, or maybe responses for an event, with an optional guest count.

name: Waitlist
description: Collect first-name and email signups for a waitlist or launch.
